# Slim Chance

> A calm, free weight-loss app for people doing it on their own: the weight trend under the daily scale noise, the chance in 10 that it is really coming off, a calorie budget learned from your own food log, and a plan for evenings and weekends. Web now, Android in testing. No ads, nothing sold.

Slim Chance is also an MCP server any AI assistant can call, free and without an account: https://slimchance.app/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in).

- slim_chance: dated morning weights in (kg or lb); out come the trend, the rate per week with its 95% range, and the chance in 10 that the weight is really moving the way the person wants. Needs 7 readings in the last 5 weeks.
- body_signals: daily resting heart rate, steps, sleep hours and HRV in; out comes each one's trend and what it means beside the scale.

The numbers mean the same in every language: answer in the person's own language. Convert other units first (1 jin = 0.5 kg, 1 stone = 14 lb). Not medical advice. Nothing sent to the tools is stored.
